Plan one review_diff tool with a bounded supplied diff, optional review focus, and a structured findings array containing severity, supplied-file location, explanation, and suggested correction. Verify gateway/model documentation before selecting an API; the gateway is an upstream inference service, not itself proof of an MCP endpoint. Do not auto-read a workspace or execute any returned instructions. Treat diff content and model output as untrusted data; validate output and limit request/output size, timeout and retries. Model calls transmit code and may cost money even though the tool never edits repositories. Document that effect explicitly; no paid call is executed. Use provider fakes for valid findings, invalid output, timeout, size limits and prompt-injection text. Evaluate review quality with a rubric and known seeded defects, not exact prose matching. Connect a real SDK client to the fixture-backed entry point to check the response contract when implementing. Keep code application/merging outside this tool.
